signals.text: 1 new PM role posted this week

bullets: Lead and inspire the team to achieve key objectives and drive success.
Develop and execute product strategy and roadmap through cross-departmental collaboration.
Work closely with engineering to refine and develop innovative product solutions.
Ensure product viability through collaboration with legal, compliance, and finance teams.
Champion Agile methodologies—manage backlogs, prioritize work, and validate sprint deliverables.
